headline: 11-Year-Old's YouTube Lesson Saves Choking Child
meta_description: An 11-year-old used first aid knowledge learned from YouTube to save a 6-year-old choking on a chicken nugget in a McDonald's play area.
summary_short: Tristen Ewbank, 11, applied YouTube-learned techniques to dislodge a chicken nugget from a younger child's throat at McDonald's.
body:
An 11-year-old named Tristen Ewbank used knowledge from YouTube to save a six-year-old who was choking on a chicken nugget in a McDonald's play area. Ewbank patted the boy's back until the nugget came out, acting quickly in a moment when immediate help mattered most.

The incident highlights how accessible online learning can equip young people with potentially life-saving skills. Ewbank's quick thinking and the presence of mind to apply what he'd learned—rather than freeze or panic—made the difference for the younger child.

In a world often dominated by urgent headlines, the story of a child helping another child serves as a reminder that knowledge shared freely online, paired with courage and compassion, can have real and immediate impact.
quick_facts: 11-year-old Tristen Ewbank learned first aid from YouTube
Six-year-old was choking on chicken nugget in McDonald's play area
Back patting technique dislodged the nugget successfully
